message.content: {"note_claim": "The Good Friday Agreement gives the UK Secretary of State for Northern Ireland power to call a border poll, including a duty if a majority for unity appears likely.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Secretary of State may by order direct the holding of a poll for the purposes of section 1 on a date specified in the order.", "reason": "Schedule 1 of the agreement text gives the Secretary of State the power to call a poll and obliges him to exercise it if a majority for a united Ireland appears likely (paragraph 2)."}

parsed.note_claim: The Good Friday Agreement gives the UK Secretary of State for Northern Ireland power to call a border poll, including a duty if a majority for unity appears likely.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Secretary of State may by order direct the holding of a poll for the purposes of section 1 on a date specified in the order.
parsed.reason: Schedule 1 of the agreement text gives the Secretary of State the power to call a poll and obliges him to exercise it if a majority for a united Ireland appears likely (paragraph 2).
